name: physical-engineering
description: Build mechanical CAD from a brief, measure exported geometry against saved requirements, preserve revisions, and deliver a repeatable handoff.

interface.longDescription: Create mechanical CAD studies through separately installed Text-to-CAD. Preserve requirements and failed runs, measure STEP and STL exports with an independent checker, revise the design, and rebuild a source-based handoff. The mechanical-part profile accepts custom single-solid models and declared dimensional, bore, keepout and mass requirements. A sensor plate is a starter; the drone battery tray and bridge are an optional assembly example with specialized checks. Digital geometry checks do not establish strength, manufacture or hardware qualification.
defaultPrompt: Use $engineer-subsystem to turn my mechanical part brief into a new CAD study with measurable requirements.
Use $verify-engineering-design to measure my CAD exports and report failed or unknown requirements.
Use $prepare-engineering-handoff to regenerate the checked CAD, source, BOM and rebuild instructions.
